Consider the independent random variables $Y_{1}, Y_{2}, …, Y_{12}$ where $Y_{i}∼Bernoulli(0.01)$ for $1 \le i \le 12$. What is the distribution of $Y = Y_{1} + Y_{2} + ⋯ + Y_{12}$?

*Hint: You may wish to make use of the following results.*

| Distribution | $M(t)$ | $t$-domain |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| $U{x_{1}, x_{2}, …, x_{n}}$ | $\frac{1}{n}(e^{x_{1}t} + e^{x_{2}t} + … + e^{x_{n}t})$ | $t ∈ R$ |
| $Bernoulli(p)$ | $1 - p + pe^{t}$ | $t ∈ R$ |
| $B(n, p)$ | $(1 - p + pe^{t})^{n}$ | $t ∈ R$ |
| $Geom(p)$ | $(pe^{t})/(1 - (1 - p)e^{t})$ | $t < - \ln (1 - p)$ |
| $NB(n, p)$ | $((pe^{t})/(1 - (1 - p)e^{t}))^{n}$ | $t < - \ln (1 - p)$ |
| $Po(λ)$ | $e^{λ(e^{t} - 1)}$ | $t ∈ R$ |
